Lichess/chess-puzzles: Move options were written by hand. A converter must list the real legal moves with python-chess and shuffle the options. The correct move is always option 0 here.
Lichess/chess-position-evaluations: Label leak: the context includes the engine line and the cp value, so the answer is in the input. Remove them from the context. Move options were written by hand.
RZ412/PokerBench: Good fit. Build the options from the actions and bet sizes that are allowed in the hand.
Mahesh111000/Hanabi_dataset: The legal moves are real. The row has no best-move label. Use the move_ratings field as the label source.
DeepMind ChessBench (searchless_chess): Move options were written by hand. Use the action-value files for real labels for each legal move.
TALES (microsoft/tale-suite): Action options were made up and the action label is empty. Only the episode score is real.
NetHack NLD: The score label is real. The sample is a summary of one game, not one step.
ianlee1996/pokerbench-8max-reasoning-tra: Good fit. The label comes from the teacher decision.
Autocast: The resolved answer is in a separate field that was not fetched, so the label is empty.
ForecastBench: The label is the market probability at the freeze date, not the resolved outcome. Use resolution files for the real target.
Diplomacy Deception (Peskov et al. 2020: Good fit. The labels are real.
stanfordnlp/craigslist_bargains: The sample is cut short, so the deal and price labels are empty. The full record has them.
kchawla123/casino: Good fit. The point scores are real.
mikelewis0/deal_or_no_dialog: The labels are real. The dialogue already shows 'deal', so predict from an earlier turn.
GTBench: The sample is a config file, not a decision. You must run the games to get data.
TextStarCraft II: The sample is a prompt template. The action options were made up and there is no label.
CivRealm: The sample is a config file. The options were made up and there is no label.
WarAgent: The label comes from a log line, but LLM agents made these decisions. Use as synthetic data only.
CDB90: The winner column was not fetched, so the label is empty. The newer cleaned version is CDB13.
DSGBench (Diverse Strategic Game Benchma: The sample is a config file with no match result. Run the benchmark to get data.
ALFWorld: The action options and labels were made up. Use the expert plan from the environment for real next actions.
ALFRED: The subgoal options and labels were made up. ALFRED has real subgoal annotations in traj_data.json.
MINT-SJTU/RoboFAC-dataset: The answer is real. The other options were made up. The question needs the video, so this row is weak as text only.
LIBERO (IPEC-COMMUNITY / physical-intell: Only the task text is real. The options and labels were made up.
RoboCasa: Only the task text is real. The options and labels were made up.
lerobot/* with task strings (CALVIN, LeR: Only the task text is real. The options and labels were made up.
DROID: Only the task text is real. The options and labels were made up.
BridgeData V2: Only the task text is real. The options and labels were made up.
CALVIN: Only the task text is real. The options and labels were made up.
BEHAVIOR-1K: Only the task text is real. The options and labels were made up. Episode length could be a real score label.
LIBERO-plus (newer, 2025-2026): Only the task text is real. The options and labels were made up.
PolyAI/banking77: The label is real. The option list was cut to 30 and the answer is always option 0. Use all 77 intents in random order.
clinc_oos (clinc150): The label is real. Use all 151 intents in a real converter.
Salesforce/xlam-function-calling-60k (su: The correct call is real. The other options were made up. License is CC BY-NC.
BFCL (Berkeley Function-Calling Leaderbo: The label is empty. The answer is in the possible_answer files.
ToolBench (OpenBMB): The correct APIs are real. Two options were made up. Use the real API list of the query.
microsoft/Taskbench: The correct tool is real. The other options were made up. Use the tool graph of the domain.
WorFBench (zjunlp): The first node is real. The other options were made up.
osunlp/Multimodal-Mind2Web (text fields: The target action is real. Use the real candidate elements of the page as options.
WebShop trajectories: This dataset is ScienceWorld data under a WebShop name. Do not use it as WebShop.
Tobi-Bueck/customer-support-tickets: Good fit. Queue and priority are real. Use the full queue list.
nvidia/HelpSteer2 (superseded by HelpSte: Good fit. The preference score is real.
openbmb/UltraFeedback: The context includes the annotator rationale, which leaks the rating. Remove it from the context.
allenai/reward-bench-2: The chosen index is assumed, not checked. Shuffle the responses and include their text.
PRM800K: Good fit. The step rating is real.
Agent-RewardBench (newer 2025): The label is real, but the context says which answer was chosen. Hide the names and shuffle.
Team-ACE/ProActEval (newer 2026): The options were made up and the label is empty.
webarenapro/agent_trajectory_reviews (ne: Label leak: the context gives the automatic outcome, and the label is agreement with it. Use the trajectory as context instead.
